$comment: Free hero rotation of the week, written by hand every Monday: see docs/editorial-data.md. weekStart is the Monday the rotation starts on (YYYY-MM-DD, server time); heroes are exact slugs from src/data/game/heroes.json. Copy the list from the game or an official Moonton post only, never from memory: leave heroes empty rather than guess. The page and its teasers hide the list by themselves once weekStart is more than 10 days old.
